name: blocks_describe
description: Everything needed to call one op: input schema, output schema, annotations, price and an example. Free.

name: blocks_run
description: Run one op of one block. `arguments` is exactly the op's own arguments (see blocks_describe), including idempotency_key and confirm_token. Paid as the op's price says; mode replay shows a recorded example for free.

name: get_run
description: Check a run started by another tool: returns its status and, once done, its outcomes. Free.

name: blocks_estimate
description: What a blocks_run of the same call would cost and which upstreams it would contact, without running it. `input` is the arguments object a blocks_run of that call would take. Free.

name: retry_run
description: Run again only the failed items of a finished run of yours, under the same run id. Costs what those items cost; send dry_run:true to see the range first.
